name: T14 B Electric Pallet Truck (1400kg)
description: The T14B electric low lift pallet truck is a robust and reliable vehicle for light to medium-duty indoor applications. With a load capacity of 1.4 tonnes, it is ideal for transporting goods horizontally over short distances on firm ground. Thanks to the ergonomically designed Linde tiller head with its easy-to-operate controls and smooth but powerful driving characteristics, the low lift pallet truck enables precise and comfortable working. The easily accessible main components and the Linde diagnostic interface enable simple maintenance and fast repairs.
metaDescription: Ergonomically designed tiller, Linde diagnostic interface, integrated charger and high availability.
